concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-plans-node]] - Braintree plan-template inheritance, EU price and dormant-customer notice qualification, and Control Panel/API boundaries for recurring-billing add-ons and discounts
warnings: Preserve the European Union scope, four-week period and six-or-more-month condition on the notice requirements.
Keep the API create/update prohibition scoped to add-ons and discounts; the page separately displays API plan creation.
State automatic inheritance only for new subscriptions and do not infer propagation to existing subscriptions.
Keep endpoint field inventories and worked request examples in the primary raw or dedicated API sources.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-plans-node]] - Node.js recurring-billing guide for plan templates, new-subscription inheritance, add-on and discount control boundaries, and subscription-time overrides
warnings: Do not duplicate the dedicated plan-create or plan-update request inventories in the concept route.
Distinguish Control Panel creation of add-ons and discounts from API plan creation.
Do not claim plan changes propagate to existing subscriptions.
